title: Tele Medicine Platform
seo_title: Tele Medicine Platform | Achala IT Solutions
meta_description: Tele Medicine Platform runs secure video consultations, e-prescriptions and follow-up care for hospitals and clinics.

blocks.x: Care that reaches past the OPD. Tele Medicine Platform runs secure video consultations, e-prescriptions and structured follow-ups for hospitals and clinics.

Tele Medicine Platform gives clinicians a complete remote-care workflow: scheduled and on-demand video consultations, e-prescriptions, patient records at hand, and follow-up scheduling. Patients join from a browser or phone, no special equipment.

items: Scheduled and walk-in sessions over encrypted video
Prescriptions issued digitally and delivered to the patient
Relevant history visible to the clinician during the call
Recovery checks scheduled and tracked to completion

blocks.x: Consultations run over encrypted video infrastructure; clinical data integrates with the hospital's systems through standard interfaces. Access follows the same discipline as in-person care: the care team and the patient, nothing wider.

items: Video and clinical data protected end to end
Consultations recorded into the hospital record
Patient consent captured before each session
Records visible to the care team only

blocks.x: Multi-speciality hospitals, specialty clinics, corporate health programs and rural-care initiatives that need specialist reach without travel.
Book a briefing with the telemedicine team. We will show the consultation workflow and the integration path for your hospital.
